# Acceptance — aiberto-aib-04-ask-host

Issue: #1127 (AIB-04)

## Design

- `.qa/design/aiberto-companion.md`
- Epic acceptance: `.qa/acceptance/aiberto-companion.md`

## Intent

Host use-case `aiberto-ask`: Better Auth actor, Core rulebook retrieval, evidence gate, text inference via extended `modules/ai`, server-side citation validation, quota/rate-limit, SSE stream — no FE chat UI.

## Preconditions

- AIB-01 Core index + `searchRulebook` on `main`
- Host Better Auth / solo identity available
- `AIBERTO_CHAT_ENABLED` controls public chat path (default off until provider ready)

## Happy Path

- [ ] Text-inference port is public on `modules/ai`; media `AiModality` catalog unchanged
- [ ] Authenticated ask retrieves rulebook hits, calls text inference only when evidence exists
- [ ] Response citations ⊆ retrieved section IDs and pinned `indexRevision` matches
- [ ] SSE/stream API emits meta → tokens/final (or unanswered) without secrets
- [ ] Flag off → fail-closed disabled / not-configured path (no provider call)
- [ ] Wired into `npm run test-gate` (T-003/T-004/T-012)

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Empty retrieval → `unanswered` (no LLM call) — SCN-006
- [ ] Fake / unknown citation IDs dropped; inventing IDs does not pass validation — SCN-007
- [ ] Provider missing / down → `NOT_CONFIGURED` / `PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE`
- [ ] Remote without session → Auth DENY (401/403) — SCN-009
- [ ] Rate limit exceeded → 429; logs/errors scrub secrets — T-012

## Regression

- [ ] Character-lore / Ollama settings / provider-credentials routes unchanged
- [ ] Media modalities still `image|3d|video|audio` only
- [ ] No Layout / App / Atlas / AIB-02 UI files touched
- [ ] Character-lore `PUBLIC_ACTIVATION` not used as chat backend

## Security Coverage

- B-auth: Actor from Host session (Better Auth / solo loopback) — client cannot invent actorId
- B-policy: `aiberto.ask` requires authenticated actor; unknown ops stay deny-by-default
- B-secrets: Provider keys stay server-side; error payloads scrubbed
- B-injection: Retrieved rule text treated as data in prompt; citations validated server-side
- SC-01/02/03/06: auth on route, no elevated origin from client, rate limit, no secret leak
- Out of scope: FE chat UI (AIB-05); tool writes (AIB-06/07)

## Assumptions

- Core rulebook ask is product-knowledge for any authenticated user (no project resource required)
- Streaming uses SSE `text/event-stream`; non-stream JSON available for tests
- FR-007–010 / SCN-006–009 / T-003/T-004/T-012 mapped as above

## Implementation Notes

- Files: `citations.ts`, `host-runtime.mjs`, `modules/ai` text-inference + rate-limit + rulebook-host, `application/aiberto-ask`, HTTP `/api/v1/ai/aiberto-ask`, Policy `aiberto.ask`, create-host wiring
- Flag `AIBERTO_CHAT_ENABLED` default off; media `AiModality` unchanged
- Unit tests: `scripts/aiberto-aib-04-ask-host.self-test.mjs` (T-003/T-004/T-012) via test-gate
